name: job_es_2026_10 — a Spanish-speaking crew's week (Upcoming)
about: Fri Oct 9 – Sat Oct 10 2026 (New York). Spanish day words read by the same resolver as English: 'el próximo martes' said on a Friday is the coming Tuesday; 'mañana a las 7am'; 'pasado mañana'; 'en 3 semanas'; 'pronto' is vague. 'El colado se canceló' cancels the pour by code (the model returned nothing for it). A confident Spanish voice note is read like text; a low-confidence one creates its event flagged for review and its move is held.
